en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Sa’d Al Ashary, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the Fitra, how much should be handed over on behalf of every head, from the wheat, and the barley, and the dates, and the raisins: ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘A Sa’a (approx. 3kg) by the Sa’a of the Prophet<sup>saww</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 5. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Khalid from Sa‘d ibn Sa‘d al-Ash’ariy who has said the following:

“I once asked al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the amount of wheat, barley, dates or raisins for each person as al-Fitrah. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is one Sa’ of the Sa‘ of the prophet, ‘Alayhi al-Salam.”’
